name: Birthday Reward - ShopStyle US
description: Daily DE-entry birthday journey with a 50/50 Random Split A/B test comparing a flat-discount creative (Variant A) against a tier-scaled-gift creative (Variant B), converging into shared post-send tracking.

exitCriteria.query: SELECT SubscriberKey FROM ShopStyle_Subscribers WHERE SubscriberStatus = 'Unsubscribed' OR EmailOptIn = 0

configurationArguments.notes: Test runs continuously (not a fixed-duration test-then-winner split) since birthday volume per day is naturally low; results reviewed monthly via sql/reporting/ab-test-results.sql.

configurationArguments.insertStatement: INSERT INTO ShopStyle_ABTestResults (TestId, JourneyKey, SubscriberKey, TestName, Variant, EntryDate, EmailNameSent) VALUES (CONCAT('JOURNEY_BIRTHDAY_LOYALTY_SHOPSTYLE_US-', Entry.SubscriberKey, '-', CAST(GETDATE() AS VARCHAR)), 'JOURNEY_BIRTHDAY_LOYALTY_SHOPSTYLE_US', Entry.SubscriberKey, 'Birthday Creative Test', 'A', GETDATE(), 'EMAIL_BIRTHDAY_VARIANT_A')

configurationArguments.subjectLine: Happy Birthday! Enjoy 20% off, on us

configurationArguments.insertStatement: INSERT INTO ShopStyle_ABTestResults (TestId, JourneyKey, SubscriberKey, TestName, Variant, EntryDate, EmailNameSent) VALUES (CONCAT('JOURNEY_BIRTHDAY_LOYALTY_SHOPSTYLE_US-', Entry.SubscriberKey, '-', CAST(GETDATE() AS VARCHAR)), 'JOURNEY_BIRTHDAY_LOYALTY_SHOPSTYLE_US', Entry.SubscriberKey, 'Birthday Creative Test', 'B', GETDATE(), 'EMAIL_BIRTHDAY_VARIANT_B')

configurationArguments.subjectLine: A birthday gift picked for your ShopStyle Rewards tier
